native.policy: All predeclared observations and all data relocations are retained. Layout movement is not itself a timing verdict. No outlier removal; 2000 deterministic resamples of 32 balanced cycles. Simulated instruction counts are not native cycles.

mixed.policy: All predeclared observations and all data relocations are retained. Layout movement is not itself a timing verdict. No outlier removal; 2000 deterministic resamples of 32 balanced cycles. Simulated instruction counts are not native cycles.

reason: The complete Clang repeat has 84 native rows with no losses beyond 1%, two original-image A/A flags, and one mixed original-image ARM raw loss. Fixed-image observations and paired identical-copy comparisons have no such loss, but the original negative observation remains unresolved pending a predeclared 64-cycle full mixed follow-up and NeverD product validation.

aa_review.scope: Diagnostic paired candidate/A/A ratios from all existing frozen cycles, plus matched fixed-inode and disabled-ASLR observations for every Clang A/A flag in both rounds. These do not replace the original baseline ratios or delete any observation.
